title: /api/srs/due/{deckId} N+1 query on user_vocabulary_progress
discovered_by: Phase 5 performance sweep (workflow), proven by sys.dm_exec_query_stats delta — not by reading the code
root_cause: SrsService.getDueWords() called progressRepository.findByUserIdAndVocabularyId(userId, vocab.getId()) INSIDE the loop over DeckWord — one query per word.

fix.repository: added List<UserVocabularyProgress> findByUserIdAndVocabularyIdIn(Long userId, Collection<Long> vocabularyIds)
fix.service: SrsService.getDueWords() now collects the deck's vocab ids, runs ONE batched query, builds Map<vocabId, progress>, and looks up in the loop
fix.preserved: F151 deck-ownership check (before any read) and F106 interval cap are untouched

regression_test: SrsDueWordsAuthzTest.dueWordsUsesOneBatchedProgressQueryNotOnePerWord — asserts findByUserIdAndVocabularyIdIn called exactly once and findByUserIdAndVocabularyId never called
verification: 5/5 tests in SrsDueWordsAuthzTest pass (4 pre-existing authz tests + the new N+1 test)

live_measurement.method: sys.dm_exec_query_stats filtered by statement text — count executions of the per-word lookup vs the batched lookup around ONE /api/srs/due/10006 call

before_fix.note: the per-word statement incremented once per deck word

after_fix.verdict: the endpoint now uses the batched query and issues ZERO per-word lookups
